answer: A Verified email inbox bound by in-person pickup code with revocation on transfer ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone tide cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. After the jetty closes and the juniper opens, the claim is frozen and published for audit.
